heading, Healthcare shouldn’t be so hard., level 1
Every year, millions of people wait weeks for simple prescriptions. They take time off work, sit in waiting rooms, and jump through hoops just to get basic care.
By building the technology that lets any company offer healthcare, we're not just solving one problem. We're creating a future where healthcare fits into life, not the other way around.
image, Cat in a space suit walking on moon with sign saying - HEALTHCARE MOONSHOT

We're on a mission. Like mission control coordinating a space launch, we orchestrate instant healthcare access, getting patients treatment in minutes not weeks, while building the infrastructure that lets any brand, any platform, anywhere become a healthcare provider.
heading, Built and led by health professionals passionate about healthcare access, level 2

Trained software engineer and emergency medicine doctor. Trailblazing a future of healthcare that can support the entire population; leading likeminded clinicians who obsess over better health outcomes for their patients.
Oskar is an accomplished medical researcher and pharmacist specialising in aging (longevity) medicine. He is responsible for driving clinical innovation at Evaro.

Thirty years of pharmacy expertise, balancing fast paced demands with methodical, steady leadership. Strengthening operations, inspiring colleagues, and leading Evaro’s thriving pharmacy team where patients receive exceptional, compassionate care.
heading, Clinical expertise you can trust, level 2

Our multidisciplinary team brings together decades of healthcare experience to ensure every prescription meets the highest clinical standards. From specialist consultants to pharmacy professionals, we've built a foundation of expertise that companies and patients can rely on.
Our team’s specialisms cover diverse therapeutic areas including sexual health, weight management and nutrition, menopause, mental health, cardiovascular, and chronic condition management.
From NHS foundations to private practice expertise, our clinicians bring comprehensive real world healthcare knowledge to every consultation.

Our clinicians have held over 30 teaching and leadership roles in both higher education and clinical settings, including lecturing, national on-call pharmacy support, teaching fellowships, and pharmacy management.
